questions.prompt: What main shift does Chapter 15 make after Chapter 14?

From satisfaction back to environment only

questions.prompt: Why do immediate outcomes often matter more than delayed ones in daily behavior?

explanation.competitive: The present self listens hardest to what pays in the present tense.
